worldcombat.skill.ingrain.summary: Lay roots into the ground below and pin yourself in place; every so often they draw up a mouthful of HP. You cannot move while rooted, and the roots must end or be cleared to pull free.
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.use.0: Pin yourself to one spot in a war of attrition for a steadier trickle of healing
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.use.1: Lay roots across the ground underfoot and mark the position
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.use.2: When chased, root for steady recovery and bet they cannot break through
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.description.0: Every %2$s s the roots restore %1$s of your maximum health to you.
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.description.1: The roots hold for about %1$s; when they run out or are cleared (milk, /effect clear, and the like) they pull free at once and release the pin.
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s; you cannot move while rooted.
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.deep.on: Deep roots: healing per pulse x1.1 and root duration x1.3; costs a x1.2 longer interval and 1 s longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.deep.off: Standard roots: slightly less per pulse but more frequent, with a shorter cooldown so you can root again sooner.
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.timing: Self move; its %1$s s wind-up can be interrupted, and an interruption costs nothing; once preparation completes it spends %3$s PP, then recovers %2$s s and starts a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ingrain.preference.dee: On: healing per pulse x1.1 and root duration x1.3, at the cost of a x1.2 longer interval and 1 s longer cooldown. Off: slightly less per pulse but more frequent and shorter cooldown.
The companion queues ingrain once its HP falls below this ratio; lower favours fighting first, higher roots at the first scratch.
With Guard Only on, root only when a threat is within this distance; larger roots earlier from further away.
Stop rooting and deal with the foe when a threat is closer than this; larger gives up rooting from further out.
On: refuse to root while standing in lava, fire, campfires, powder snow, cactus or water. Off: root on any footing.
On: root only when a threat is inside the guard distance, confirming someone is coming before pinning down. Off: root whenever hurt, threat or not.
